promptSet: Create an original editorial illustration for the named article using sophisticated contemporary magazine illustration, geometric cut-paper shapes with subtle screen-print grain, crisp silhouettes and layered depth. Use a wide 16:10 landscape composition with a strong central focal point and safe crop margins. Palette: deep navy, clear red, muted sky blue, warm cream and charcoal. No text, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, photorealism or identifiable real person.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a see-saw on a navy pivot, with a stack of sturdy blue-chip blocks rising on one end and a cluster of red chip and server shapes sliding down on the other, against an exchange skyline
items.brief: The Dow closing back above 50,000 while AI and chip stocks give up Nvidia’s record one-day surge, shown as a see-saw on a navy pivot with a stack of sturdy blue-chip blocks (a hospital cross and shopping-bag shapes among them) lifted on one end under a small flag, and a cluster of red chip and server-rack shapes sliding down on the other end with a faint ghosted taller silhouette behind it, in front of an exchange-building skyline.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a tall archive tower of record drawers split by a red fracture beneath a magnifying glass, with a patrol-car silhouette at a roadside stop and a federal building behind
items.brief: The FBI’s investigation into an apparent breach of the National Crime Information Center, the nationwide database police use for warrant checks, shown as a tall archive tower of record drawers split by a red fracture beneath a magnifying glass, with a patrol-car silhouette at a roadside stop and a federal building behind.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a brass exchange opening bell above a staircase of server-rack blocks that peaks and settles on a higher step, with a dimmer row of falling bars and a neoclassical exchange facade behind
items.brief: Anthropic's record Nasdaq IPO debut and the fade from its opening spike, shown as an opening bell above a staircase of server-rack blocks that peaks, then settles on a higher step above a red baseline, with a dimmer row of falling bars and an exchange facade behind.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a Capitol dome rising behind snow-capped Alaska peaks, with a ballot box, a salmon drying rack and a small bush plane in the foreground and a balanced scale at the center
items.brief: Democrat Mary Peltola’s win in Alaska’s Senate race and the unresolved fight over certification, shown as a Capitol dome rising behind snow-capped Alaska peaks with a ballot box, a salmon drying rack and a small bush plane in the foreground and a balanced scale at the center.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a congressional hearing-room dais with a gavel and a stack of sealed letters facing the columns of a federal building, a Capitol dome behind them and a balanced scale at the center
items.brief: White House and Justice Department warnings that Democratic oversight probes could be criminal, shown as a hearing-room dais with a gavel and sealed letters facing a federal building, with a Capitol dome and a balanced scale behind.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a stack of server cubes with several gone dark, a stalled envelope queue and a globe of severed connection lines linking a courthouse, a hospital cross and a government dome
items.brief: Microsoft 365 global outage that disrupted email, Teams and Copilot for governments, courts, healthcare services and businesses worldwide, shown as a server stack with dark cubes, a stalled envelope queue and a globe of severed connection lines.

items.brief: Cabinet rift over AI-chip export controls: two secretaries at a government table, a stack of AI chips and a blacklist ledger between them, with a Senate hearing room behind.

items.brief: Microsoft’s multi-year data-center buildout to triple computing power, with rising server racks and power forms.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a large navy shield cracked by a red fracture, with a row of small figure shapes beneath it and a single syringe silhouette, set against a pale map of the Americas
items.brief: The U.S. losing its measles elimination status after more than 25 years, shown as a large navy shield split by a jagged red fracture at the centre of the frame, a pale cream map of the Americas behind it with a few small red spot shapes scattered across it, a row of small simple cut-paper figure silhouettes standing beneath the shield (a few in muted sky blue, a few left as empty cream outlines), and a single syringe silhouette angled in the lower corner.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of an empty chair at the head of a long conference table in front of a government-building facade, with a stack of unopened voucher envelopes and a pill capsule shape on the table
items.brief: The White House pulling its FDA commissioner nominee while the agency’s fast-track review programme stalls, shown as an empty high-backed chair at the head of a long charcoal conference table in front of a columned government-building facade, a stack of unopened cream envelopes marked only by a red seal shape and a single pill-capsule shape resting on the table, with a faint clock-face circle stalled behind the chair.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a rising bar-shaped skyline of hospital beds and a thermometer silhouette, with a wave of red virus shapes sweeping across a pale map of the United States
items.brief: An early flu wave pushing hospital admissions to seven times last year’s level, shown as a rising skyline of stacked hospital-bed and bar shapes in navy climbing steeply from left to right beside a short pale ghost bar for last year, a large thermometer silhouette in clear red at the centre, and a sweep of small red virus-particle circles flowing across a cream map of the United States behind them.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a single large pill capsule balanced on a scale against a stack of injection pens, with a pale map of China and a faint measuring-tape curve behind them
items.brief: Eli Lilly winning China’s first approval for an oral GLP-1 weight-loss pill, shown as one large cream-and-red pill capsule balanced on a navy scale against a tall stack of slim injection-pen shapes that is outweighed and tipping upward, a muted sky-blue silhouette of China behind them with a measuring-tape curve winding across it and a small cut-paper pagoda roofline at the horizon.

items.alt: Editorial illustration of a tall stack of insurance-card shapes rising like a staircase toward a red upward arrow, with a small figure on a landing and an open window onto a calendar page
items.brief: Rising ACA health-insurance premiums as enhanced subsidies end, shown as a tall staircase built from stacked cream insurance-card shapes climbing toward a bold red upward arrow, a small navy figure silhouette standing on a lower landing looking up, a cut-paper window at the side opening onto a calendar page with a ring around one day, and a faint half-erased subsidy shield in the background.
